final: SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM Patient AS p JOIN (SELECT ID, MIN(`Examination Date`) AS first_exam_date FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID) AS e ON e.ID = p.ID WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', e.first_exam_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1
